segments.thag5.9:1.3: Na taṃ pāpe niyojessaṃ, kāmajāla [kāmajālaṃ (syā.)] sarīraja [sarīrajaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.thag5.9:2.1: “Tvaṃ olaggo na gacchasi [na gañchisi (pī)], dvāravivaraṃ gajova alabhanto;
segments.thag5.9:2.3: Na ca cittakali punappunaṃ, pasakka [pasahaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] pāparato carissasi.
segments.thag5.9:3.3: Balavā āvatteti akāmaṃ, evaṃ āvattayissaṃ taṃ.
segments.thag5.9:4.3: Evaṃ damayissaṃ taṃ, patiṭṭhito pañcasu balesu.
segments.thag5.9:5.1: “Satiyā taṃ nibandhissaṃ, payutto te damessāmi [payatatto vodapessāmi (sī.)];
segments.thag5.9:5.3: Vīriyadhuraniggahito, na yito dūraṃ gamissase cittā”ti.
